subject: Request: temporary backup purge waiver & log retention runbook for Aurelia Labs audit
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@aurellab.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurellab.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request + ask to pause scheduled backup purge for Aurelia audit

Hi Marissa / Logan,

Quick heads-up: Aurelia's compliance team is running an unannounced clinical data audit next week. They're asking us to ensure a matching retention window for a specific customer subset while they complete evidence collection. Right now our nightly backup purge is scheduled for 2027-06-24 (finalized snapshot rotation). If we proceed with the purge it will remove snapshots that Aurelia requires for the audit.

Can we request a temporary waiver to defer the purge for 30 days for vendor ID AUR-2022-07? They only need access to the snapshots and associated request logs (service side logs & delivery receipts). I've attached the initial evidence matrix with the list of records they flagged (aurelia_evidence_request_0622.xlsx).

What we need from Redwood:
- Short confirmation that a 30-day hold on the scheduled purge is possible for the listed snapshots (they understand this is exceptional)
- Clarify which logs will remain accessible (transaction logs vs. debug traces)
- Any ask from your side for proof of legal authority/POC from Aurelia

Thanks — Elena
Elena Martinez
Compliance Lead | Aurelia Labs

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request + ask to pause scheduled backup purge for Aurelia audit

Kimberly / Logan / Laura — looping you in. Aurelia sent an evidence matrix and is explicitly asking we delay the 6/24 purge for a small set of snapshots they identified.

Immediate asks:
- Kimberly: legal to confirm what language we can accept in a retention waiver and whether we need a signed DocuSign from procurement. I can share a redlineable waiver template.
- Logan: on-call infra — can we stage a 30-day hold for the snapshot IDs (I noted them in the spreadsheet) without impacting our retention rolloff logic for other customers? Also, what logs will be retained by default vs. what we can extract for evidence?
- Laura: please prepare a short runbook for operations to implement the hold and the rollback steps if the audit completes earlier. Include checks to prevent accidental permanent retention.

I attached Aurelia's matrix. This needs a quick turn (same day) if possible. I'll coordinate external comms once we have a path.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, elena.martinez@aurellab.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request + ask to pause scheduled backup purge for Aurelia audit

Thanks Marissa — quick legal note: we can approve a limited, timeboxed waiver provided we have procurement sign-off and a scoped statement of purpose. Suggested terms (drafted for quick turnaround):

- Scope: apply to snapshots listed in Aurelia spreadsheet (AUR-IDs listed)
- Duration: 30 calendar days from approval date (option to extend by mutual written agreement, max one 30-day extension)
- Access: Redwood will provide read-only access for evidence collection; no exports outside the approved contact list
- Logging: Preserve service transaction logs and delivery receipts for the subject window; ephemeral debug traces can be omitted unless specifically requested with justification
- Audit trail: procurement to sign DocuSign; legal needs PO/official audit letter

I created a DocuSign envelope (link below) and opened a Jira ticket to track orchestration (INFRA-6421). Please attach the signed DocuSign and procurement evidence to the ticket.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/EXAMPLE/redirect?docId=12345
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-6421

Kimberly Park
Lead Counsel, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: elena.martinez@aurellab.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request + ask to pause scheduled backup purge for Aurelia audit

On-call notes and runbook draft below. Quoting for context.

Operational runbook (draft):
1) Snapshot hold: mark identified snapshot IDs (see attached snapshot_manifest_0621.csv) as "audit_hold" in retention service. This will exclude them from scheduled purge jobs while preserving normal GC for unrelated snapshots.
2) Log retention: preserve transaction/log-entry stream for timestamps covering the snapshot windows. We will not retain high-volume debug traces by default; if Aurelia requests specific debug segments, they'll need to justify and we'll pull on demand.
3) Access: create a temporary, read-only S3 export bucket with strict ACLs for the Aurelia compliance contacts; set a 30-day TTL on the bucket and audit every 7 days.
4) Rollback: automated unhold on approval expiration; manual rollback via infra runbook if audit ends early (requires 2 engineers to sign off).
5) Safeguards: add a JIRA checklist step to verify "audit_hold" tags are only on AUR-* IDs before purge.

Risks & mitigation:
- Increased short-term storage cost. Finance notified via ticket INFRA-6421.
- Human error on manual rollback — require 2-person verification.

Attachments: snapshot_manifest_0621.csv (list of snapshot hashes + creation dates)

Laura Bennett
SRE Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: elena.martinez@aurellab.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@aurellab.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request + ask to pause scheduled backup purge for Aurelia audit

Elena — thanks for the quick context and to the team for the fast turnaround. Per legal + infra runbook above, Redwood will implement a 30-day hold on the listed snapshots as an exception. Next steps:
1) Aurelia procurement to sign DocuSign (link below) and confirm PO or audit letter — we need that in Jira INFRA-6421 to close the loop.
2) Infra will tag snapshots as "audit_hold" by EOD 2027-06-23; SRE will create the read-only export bucket and send access instructions to the contact list.
3) Laura will run the rollback checklist if the audit completes earlier.
4) Finance and billing have been notified of the temporary storage delta; invoice impact will be tracked to the associated account.

Elena — please sign the DocuSign and confirm the primary contact who will pull evidence (name + email). Once we have the signed DocuSign we will mark the Jira ticket "in progress" and implement the hold.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/EXAMPLE/redirect?docId=12345
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-6421

Thanks all — will update when the snapshot tags are applied.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
